# `table`

Helper: `table(cols, rows, { foot })`, `cell(items, { row })`  
Kit (`src/ui`): `TableShell` (`table-shell.ts`, re-export) · status: src/ui  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaCareRow` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Wrapper with a header row (micro, uppercase, table-head fill), data rows with dividers, optional footer row.

## Variants

- Up to 7 columns
- `foot` summary row
- `empty`: single empty row
- Row hover fill for a clickable row

## States

- Hover: row-hover (clickable rows)
- Empty row: centred ink-soft text

## Tokens

surface, line, table-head, row-hover, ink-soft, text-micro, text-body, radius-card

## Do

- Use for 3+ comparable rows
- Put the main identifier in the first column

## Don't

- Do not use more than 7 columns
- Do not use a table for two or three facts (facts)

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Grid columns by `cols`; padding 12/16.

## Mobile (390)

Header hides; every row becomes a card, the first cell is the title and each other cell shows its column label above its value.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Up to 7 columns. At 390 every row becomes a card (first cell = title, others under their column label). Use a table for 3+ comparable rows, `list` or cards otherwise. `{ empty: 'Không có lịch phù hợp.' }` with `rows = []` draws the single empty row (old `<EmptyRow>`)
